approval.scope: Destination-specific delivery of the TRR-0010 proposed common contract, public/hash-only reservation metadata, and bounded compute schedule to A2 for review; this approval does not freeze the contract or authorize fitting, GPU execution, source selection, truth access, or final evaluation.
approval.approval_source: Root reported the user response to the explicit destination-specific handoff request.

destination.title: Agent2 Run no-fit boundary pilot verified same-project

delivery.fit_boundary: No TRR-0010 fit proceeds before A2 agreement and resource qualification.

current_b0.role: exact published TRR-0009 improved public fitting bank, reused unchanged

expanded_b1.role: nested expanded fitting bank, pending A2 recipe and identity bindings

public_validation.role: opened public development selection panel; not final truth

known_exclusion_ledgers: approved P08 r1/r2 opaque hash-only ledgers
final panel and validation rows excluded from new B1 additions

compute_schedule.cap_action: stop and revise contract before fit; never silently cap
compute_schedule.checkpoint_rule: replace N, sort/deduplicate, earliest maximum with earliest tie
compute_schedule.readout_path: full merged W for training/validation/inference; sparse path diagnostic-only

must_resolve_with_a2_before_fit: Bind the exact B1 recipe, mixture, parent/row identities, controlled-draw semantics, and opaque exclusion/hash receipts.
Bind the B0/B1 sampler and actual valid-position count so the common formula-derived N is concrete before fitting.
Bind the validation/final panel identity and sequence ledgers, record order, and zero-overlap checks; keep 384 public_base validation separate from the 128/domain final panel.
Agree the executable support-ID/count and merged-W serialization interface, including output-equivalence and largest-cell resource qualification prerequisites.
Agree preparation and compute accounting: shared preparation once, four equal optimizer opportunities, and fail-closed wall/disk/host-RSS/GPU guards before any matrix.

preserved_prior_rejection.meaning: Historical automatic-review rejection remains unchanged; this approval supersedes only its destination-specific block.
